name: browser-use-playwright
description: The PLAYWRIGHT PROVIDER of the browser-use@1 seam (provider id `playwright`): it drives a real chromium through `playwright-core` - session lifecycle, navigate, the compact SNAPSHOT with SHORT STABLE refs, the full act vocabulary (click/type/fill/select/hover/scroll/press/upload/check/focus/waitFor/back/forward/reload), evaluate, readable extract (text/markdown/html/table/attributes/links/json), FILE screenshots, tabs, waits, downloads/network observation and storage-state reuse. It is LOCATION-AGNOSTIC: the `backend` config row decides WHERE the browser runs (local | container | ssh | ssh+container | http), mirroring the himalaya impl plugin, and every non-local backend reaches the browser through the general-service@1 seam under the hood. It reuses the SHARED chromium launcher of this repository (`shared/browser.ts`) instead of forking a second browser stack, so `web-page`, `web-session` and this provider never launch competing browsers. A deployment without a browser fails with the typed `browser-use.no-browser` / `browser-use.endpoint-unreachable` error naming the exact prerequisite - never a silent fallback to a non-browser fetch.

config.description: WHERE the browser runs is a CONFIG decision (`backend`: local | container | ssh | ssh+container | http), never a hardcoded endpoint/image/launch-mode: the plugin is location-agnostic like the himalaya impl plugin, and every non-local backend reaches the browser through the general-service@1 seam (probe/start). Backwards compatible: `backend` may be omitted and is then inferred (browserService -> container, a bare wsEndpoint/cdpEndpoint -> http, otherwise local), so the existing `browserService: { endpoint: http://browser:9222, image: ... }` config keeps working unchanged as the container-mode default.

backend.description: WHERE the browser runs. `local`: a chromium launched by this provider (`executablePath` or the playwright cache). `container`: a compose browser service of the stack (CDP attach to `browserService.endpoint`, probe/start through the seam). `ssh` / `ssh+container`: a browser on a REMOTE machine (probe/start through the seam). `http`: a remote CDP endpoint over http. Absent: inferred (browserService -> container, wsEndpoint/cdpEndpoint -> http, otherwise local).

headless.description: Run the shared chromium without a window. It is a LAUNCH-time setting of the shared process, so a session cannot change it.

viewport.description: Default viewport of a session (a session may override it).

userAgent.description: Default user agent of a session.

proxy.description: Default proxy of a session. `credential` is the NAME of a credentials entry, never a value: it is resolved through the credentials service at launch time.

credential.description: the NAME of the credential holding the proxy password

executablePath.description: A chromium/chrome binary to launch for the `local` backend. Absent: playwright resolves its own cache (`PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`).

wsEndpoint.description: A REMOTE browser to ATTACH to instead of launching a local chromium: a CDP/websocket endpoint (`ws://browser:3000/`, `http://browser:9222`). When set, the provider connects over CDP and NEVER launches a local process; an endpoint that does not answer fails with the typed `browser-use.endpoint-unreachable` naming it - no silent local launch, no silent HTTP fetch. `cdpEndpoint` is accepted as an alias. A bare endpoint (no `browserService`) selects the `http` backend.

cdpEndpoint.description: Alias of `wsEndpoint`, for a caller that thinks in CDP terms.

browserService.description: The SEPARATE browser service (its own image) this provider ATTACHES to, e.g. the stack `browser` service. `endpoint` is where it answers (`http://browser:9222`); `image` is named in answers/errors; `generalService` is the general-service@1 instance (type + params: container / ssh / ssh+container / http) used to START/probe that service when the endpoint does not answer yet - the SEAM decides the transport, this provider never hard-wires docker or ssh. When `generalService` is absent it is built FROM the `backend` (type = backend, params = the backend's block).

endpoint.description: Where the browser service answers: `http://host:port` or a `ws(s)://` CDP URL, e.g. `http://browser:9222`.

image.description: The image the service runs (named in the answers/errors), e.g. `ghcr.io/nexuslbs/workstation-plugins/browser:0.0.3`.

generalService.description: The general-service@1 instance (`type` + `params`) that probes/starts the service. Absent: built from the `backend`.

start.description: The command run THROUGH the instance when the endpoint does not answer (start it).

probe.description: A command run through the instance as a liveness/diagnostic proof (reported when the start fails).

startTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the endpoint after `start`.

ssh.description: The `ssh` backend params (host, user, key name, binary): they become the general-service@1 instance params of type `ssh` when `browserService.generalService` does not name an instance itself.

container.description: The `container` backend params (engine, compose project/service): they become the general-service@1 instance params of type `container` when `browserService.generalService` does not name an instance itself.

http.description: The `http` backend params (the control endpoint of the remote browser): they become the general-service@1 instance params of type `http` when `browserService.generalService` does not name an instance itself.

browserArgs.description: Extra chromium argv, handed over verbatim (argv, never a shell string).

storageStateDir.description: Where the per-session storage-state files live (default `<tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use/state`), the SAME convention `web-session` uses.

screenshotDir.description: Where a screenshot without an explicit path is written (default `<tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use`; a relative value is resolved against the CWD). This provider OWNS the file it writes, so this value WINS over the host bound `plugins.browser-use-impl.screenshotDir`, and the answered path is always ABSOLUTE.

downloadDir.description: Where a session's downloads are saved (default `<storageStateDir>/downloads`).

launchTimeoutMs.description: Budget of the shared chromium launch.

defaultSession.description: The session id a call uses when it names none.

observeLimit.description: How many requests/downloads the per-session observer keeps.

sessionTtlSeconds.description: Idle seconds after which a session's context is closed (0 = never).
